assets.caption: EXHIBIT 6-43 Overhead Piping Arrangements for a Condensing Air Cooler
assets.notes: Two stacked elevation sketches comprising a single exhibit. Top sketch shows an air cooler bundle supported above a tower with overhead piping and a handwritten note 'EXTEND AIR COOLER SUPPORT STEEL TO SUPPORT OVERHEAD LINE,' plus a dashed alternative routing annotated 'COST-EFFECTIVE ALTERNATIVE ROUTING IF PIPING IS FLEXIBLE AND CAN SPAN DISTANCE WITHOUT INTERMEDIATE SUPPORT.' Bottom sketch shows the air cooler over a tower with overhead piping dropping between sections through a hatched pipe rack, annotated 'FOR FLEXIBILITY, THE AIR COOLER CAN BE POSITIONED WITH THE INLET NOZZLES ON THE FAR CENTERLINE OF THE PIPE RACK COLUMNS. THE AIR COOLER SECTIONS SHOULD BE SEGREGATED AND THE STEEL EXTENDED TO SUPPORT THE OVERHEAD PIPING.' Exhibit label/title block appears at upper-right of the page.
